name: Watermark Queue
purpose: Async watermark application to newly uploaded image and video content, processes items in FIFO order
retryPolicy: 3 retries with exponential backoff (1min, 5min, 15min); dead-letter after final failure

name: Payout Queue
purpose: Batch processing of creator payout requests, scheduled daily processing
retryPolicy: 3 retries with 1-hour intervals; manual intervention required after final failure

name: Email Queue
purpose: Transactional email delivery for verification emails, password reset, notifications, marketing communications
retryPolicy: 5 retries with exponential backoff (1min, 5min, 15min, 1hr, 6hr); discard after final failure

name: Notification Queue
purpose: Real-time in-app notification delivery via WebSocket, push notification processing for mobile users
retryPolicy: 2 retries immediately; fallback to email queue if undelivered

name: Caption Queue
purpose: AI-powered caption and description generation for newly uploaded content via OpenAI API
retryPolicy: 2 retries with 30-second delay; skip caption generation on failure

name: Cleanup Queue
purpose: Scheduled cleanup of expired content, orphaned files in R2, stale session data, and soft-deleted records
retryPolicy: 2 retries with 1-hour delay; log failures for manual review
